polygon.title: Polygon

polygon.empty: Draw a polygon with at least three vertices.

area.title: Area
area.empty: Draw a polygon with at least three vertices to see its area.

difference.equal: The two areas are nearly identical

area.utmUnavailable: UTM is unavailable for this polygon.
area.explanation: Geodesic area is the reference on the WGS84 ellipsoid. UTM area projects all vertices into one zone and applies Shoelace, so it is affected by projection distortion (especially far from the central meridian and across zones).

warnings.multi-zone: The polygon spans more than one UTM zone; area was computed in the centroid zone ({{zone}}{{hemisphere}}) and may be less accurate.
warnings.multi-hemisphere: The polygon crosses the equator; UTM area was stopped because Northing differs between hemispheres.
warnings.antimeridian: The polygon crosses the International Date Line; UTM area was stopped because the projection is unreliable.
warnings.outside-utm-range: The polygon is outside the UTM range (−80° to 84°); only geodesic area is shown.
